mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the nerve routes was most worthwhile: it showed how the sensors could help keep the eyes on a point and adjust posture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the weighted sensors was a little confusing because the separate balance nerves had already been used. Inspecting resolved it, but the required pairing was not obvious to me.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the weighted sensors joined through the turning-sensor assembly rather than a separate nerve item.

arbitrary.text: That same pairing felt somewhat arbitrary before the compatibility hint; afterward, the picture showed both sensor types connected to incoming nerve fibres.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter. Seeing how the balance sensors connect to eye movement was interesting, although I would hope for similarly clear explanations.
